None.

Reused from 46a96605, whose policy/MCP/JVM code is unchanged by the master diff and whose affected analysis/core/store paths are now directly covered: policy-integration 2578/2578 (108 skipped), contract-tests 2929/2929 (781 skipped), JVM focused 9/9, root cross-language/suite_issues/suite_semantic 15/15.
Baseline failures: none: every selected check passed; no ledger or repository baseline failure was reproduced.
Downstream: schema-7 policy JSON/human/SARIF and subject verdicts -> MCP contract tests reused from 46a966; suite_cross_language member-family goldens reused from 46a966; suite_issues issue_2580/5133 reused and issue_3134/9925 rerun; suite_semantic oracle reused and ICFG domain rerun; analysis/core project, store Rust reverse/planner, and tools configuration paths rerun in the 861-test focused selection; MCP conformance not run because no wire-schema change; ignored operator/JDK census tests not run because they require operator inputs.

item.author: mergemarshall[bot]

session.conversation:
User: Read-only source audit, ONE job, no edits/commits/builds/tests/PRs. You share .mj/lanes/10985-m2b, which is SUBMITTED ReadyPR11241 exact50ec61e423; do not mutate or run gates there. [redacted] owns M4 architecture and requested this audit to test a concrete proof proposal, not delegate schema/design. [redacted]; any scratch under configuredTMPDIR only.

Question: for one selected typestate subject, can every possible reported finding primary location be bounded by the complete compiled event-binding and terminal-binding sites for that subject, plus its recorded unproven-event-relation observation sites? Audit and TRY TO DISPROVE this claim, with exact source paths/lines and conditions.

Starting facts checked by parent on50ec61:
- typestate_policy.rs::subject_verdicts currently emits only Unbounded partial Selected/Undecided; realv7 FindingLocationBound has onlyUnbounded. Do NOT invent boundedv7JSON or change contract.
- flow/typestate/finding.rs PendingTypestateFinding appears to mint site from event_binding.site or terminal_binding.site; policy typestate_policy::projected_report takes primary=policy_location(finding.site()).
- BoundTypestateEvent/Terminal have subject IDs and sites; unproven relations retain subject/site/observation_procedure. Global binding_omissions or missing subjects would force any proposed bound unbounded.
- Need FULL audit of production solver paths AND composition fast path, implicit/summary-derived events, call/return rebasing/contextual bindings, multiple roots/selectedsites, persisted RootProduct hit projection/rehydration. Missing calls or partial solve cannot be assumed spatially local without checking how new finding sites arise.

Deliver: enumerate every site-minting/projection path; identify any path that can put a finding for thissubject outside that finite set without a binding omission; state necessary completeness/identity conditions and what persists across RootProduct hits; inspect procedure locator anchors
[Message truncated.]
Agent: I’ll trace finding-site creation and projection, try to find a path outside the proposed set, and send the read-only report to the parent. I won’t run gates or change the submitted lane.
Agent: Both the solver and composition paths take the primary site from a compiled binding. The main edge case so far is event templates: they live separately from `event_bindings()`, but the finding lookup can resolve them. I’m checking rebasing and persisted products before treating the proposed set as complete.
Agent: I haven’t found a path outside the full binding set. Partial or missing call analysis can change the state and certainty at a binding, but the finding still uses that binding’s site. Two caveats matter: the set must include templates, and a procedure locator cannot substitute for body locations—the source explicitly documents Ruby’s header-only anchors.
Agent: The audit supports the claim for a fixed, complete compiled binding universe, including templates. RootProduct hits preserve projected locations, but their stored gaps do not preserve the full subject/site/procedure relation records. Rehydration also does not re-prove byte-range membership, so the argument relies on valid products minted under the same compile identity. I’m sending the cited report now.
Agent: Sent the cited audit to parent. Claim holds under the stated completeness and identity conditions, including event templates. Lane unchanged.
